test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

AMPLE
solution: The correct answer is '**Sufficient**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Ample**' is '**Sufficient**'. • **Ample**: enough or more than enough. (पर्याप्त या पर्याप्त से अधिक; प्रचुर) • *Example: We’ve got **ample** time to make a decision.* • **Sufficient**: as much as is necessary; enough. (जितना आवश्‍यक हो उतना; पर्याप्त) • *Example: We **have** sufficient oil reserves to last for three months.* **Correct Answer:__** *Sufficient.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Meager**: too small in amount. (बहुत कम, स्‍वल्‍प) • **Narrow**: having only a short distance from side to side. (तंग, संकीर्ण) • **Short**: not measuring much from one end to the other. [छोटा (लंबाई में)] 42:T736, The correct answer is 'shouted'.
